papers.mapping: SCC successors require completed predecessor output before snapshot capture. The batch/tail protocol is our runtime refinement obligation, not a theorem proved by the paper.

correction: Correct source/design descriptions: task completion after credited batches and terminal-tail merge releases successors and permits worker reuse; worker/monitor joins occur at whole-pool exit. Scheduling behavior is unchanged.

lean.scope: Incoming IndexedIteration proves synchronous compiled indexed batch/history equivalence; scheduler protocol remains TLA+ territory.

tla.scope: Existing finite ReadyComponents DAG fixture now captures dispatch snapshots, an intermediate batch and terminal tail, and credit before completion. Cancel may drain a task before any batch, but outstanding credit is refused before completion. No arbitrary DAG semantic closure or fairness/native extraction claim.

native.discriminator: Predecessor emits 32-row batch, receives merge credit, then blocks. Successor stays unassigned until predecessor transfers its terminal 1-row tail; captured snapshot contains all 33 rows and remains at 33 after successor emits.
